actions.reason: The K4_C0001|K4_C0004 boundary is weak and conflicting: CT fails to represent it (mean silhouette -0.027, negative fraction 0.60) and RNA/WSI are only faintly positive, while the union eigengap is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1, gap 0.492 vs k=2 0.334), which is merge-compatible. Membership representation is also weak for both sets (K4_C0001: CT negative with negative fraction 1.0; K4_C0004: RNA and WSI negative), and the pair union is markedly imbalanced (770 vs 199), consistent with a single-cluster-dominated union. This supports a provisional merge for re-review rather than preserving two weakly separated units.

actions.reason: This set carries a coherent, interpretable transcriptomic identity (coordinated OXPHOS, interferon, immune, ROS and complement down-regulation with TGF-beta up-regulation; OXPHOS NES -2.220), and that identity is directionally opposite to the OXPHOS-up phenotype of K4_C0002, so it is not a redundant duplicate. Membership representation is weak and partially conflicting (CT negative, RNA marginal, WSI/WXS modest), and the pair boundaries to K4_C0002 and K4_C0003 are only limited-to-weak. However, the internal-subdivision screen shows candidate_k=1 with no feasible k>=2 separation, so no split is supported, and the merge that produced this set was already executed and re-reviewed here. No remaining decision-relevant evidence could plausibly rescue a different structural outcome, so the set is retained as a defensible discovery-stage unit.

This set has a strong, interpretable transcriptomic identity (coordinated OXPHOS, protein-secretion, fatty-acid, adipogenesis, mTORC1 and peroxisome up-regulation; OXPHOS NES 2.788), directionally opposite to K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004. Membership representation is conflicting and predominantly weak-to-negative (CT small positive; RNA, WSI and WXS negative with high negative fractions), and the boundary to K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004 is weak. The boundary to K4_C0003 is the strongest in the partition (ARI 0.846, within 0.570 vs between 0.193, union candidate_k=2 aligned with the current two-way structure), which positively supports preserving this unit's boundary. Internal subdivision screens at candidate_k=1 with no feasible k>=2 separation, so no split is supported. The set is retained as a defensible discovery-stage unit.

Membership representation is mixed (CT and RNA positive; WSI and WXS marginally negative), and the boundary to K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004 is weak. The boundary to K4_C0002 is the strongest in the partition (ARI 0.846, within 0.570 vs between 0.193, union candidate_k=2 aligned with the current two-way structure), positively supporting preservation of this unit. Internal subdivision screens at candidate_k=1 with no feasible k>=2 separation, so no split is supported. The set is retained as a defensible discovery-stage unit.
